greet.text: A traveller! Not many come up the north road these days. I'm Maren - I keep this waystation.

choices.text: I killed the wolves north of here. All of them.
Why don't people come this way?
You're not afraid of an orc on your doorstep?
My people still sing of these hills.

greet_again.text: Back again? The kettle's still warm.

choices.text: Tell me about the wolves again.
I'll deal with the Greyfang pack.
I have a wolf pelt to sell.

wolves.text: The Greyfang pack. They took two carts last month, and they den past the stone wall, to the north-east. Riverwatch won't send guards past the old bridge.

accept.text: Truly? Then may the road be kind to you. Three of them, maybe more. Mind their teeth - and don't let them circle you.

orc_line.text: Orcs pay in coin like anyone else. And you'd be handy against what's out there.

choices.text: Why don't people come this way?

elf_line.text: Then you'll know the old songs warn of wolves. They weren't wrong.

reward.text: All of them? Then the north road is open again. Here - it isn't much, but it's honest coin. And take this, in case the next pack is bigger.

greet_hero.text: The one who cleared the north road! Sit, rest your feet.

choices.text: I have a wolf pelt to sell.

buy_pelt.text: Greyfang fur, and a clean cut too. Fifteen gold.
